name: net_desynced_twice_ends_alone
description: Three clients. Client 3's gold is corrupted at tick 2,000: RESYNC(desync) brings it back in step. Corrupted again later, it differs a second time, past max_resyncs (1): the sequencer sends it alone MATCH_END(desynced, desynced_twice), LEFT goes into the turns so the caretaker keeps its seat, and clients 1 and 2 play on in agreement. Client 3 writes its dump and is out of the match.

steps.assert: ended and scene.client(3).outcome == 'desynced' and scene.client(3).end_reason == 'desynced_twice' and scene.seq.ended_alone == [2]
steps.msg: the second desync ended the match for client 3 alone: desynced_twice
LEFT went into the turns: the caretaker keeps seat 3
and their hash streams agree to the end
